title: How to organize the outdoor dining zone | Patio or Deck
description:
Feed people outdoors without carrying the kitchen out in four trips.

This is the Outdoor Dining Zone in the Patio or Deck. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A bare tabletop except the umbrella and one weighted tray, six chairs tucked fully under, string lights clipped along the rail with no cord crossing the floor, and nothing stored beneath the table.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Clear the table down to bare surface and face what has been living on it: a citronella bucket burned to the ri
Straighten: Chairs tuck fully under the table so nobody has to sidestep a chair leg carrying a hot dish.
Shine: Wash the tabletop along the grain and pay attention to the collar where the umbrella pole passes through, sinc
Safety: An open umbrella is a sail.
Standardize: The table's resting state is bare except for the umbrella and the one weighted tray.
Sustain: The last person carrying a plate inside closes the umbrella and lifts the tray on the way past.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Bare table plus umbrella and one weighted tray, umbrella cranked down whenever the table is empty.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/patio-or-deck-the-outdoor-dining-zone.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
